insights.title: User Authentication Workflow Detected
insights.description: The sequence for user authentication was consistently observed across multiple tests, indicating a stable login process.
insights.recommendation: Consider documenting the authentication workflow for clarity.

insights.title: High Latency in SIMS Finance Home
insights.description: The POST /sfdemosite130/simsfinance.home endpoint recorded a p95 latency of 18832 ms, indicating a significant performance issue.
insights.recommendation: Investigate the backend processing for the simsfinance.home endpoint to reduce latency.

insights.title: High Latency in RSS310Q Header Results
insights.description: The GET /sfdemosite130/rss310q_header_results.xsp endpoint showed a p95 latency of 6292 ms, which may affect report generation.
insights.recommendation: Analyze the performance of the RSS310Q report generation process.

insights.title: Repeated Calls to Refresh Control
insights.description: The POST /sfdemosite130/nml510_refresh_control.xml endpoint was called 25 times in a single test, indicating potential inefficiencies.
insights.recommendation: Evaluate the necessity of multiple calls to this endpoint and consider optimizing the workflow.

executiveSummary:
• The user authentication process is stable and consistently executed across tests. 
• High latency was observed in the SIMS Finance home endpoint, which may impact user experience. 
• The RSS310Q report generation showed significant delays, potentially affecting reporting efficiency. 
• Multiple calls to the refresh control endpoint suggest inefficiencies that warrant investigation. 
• Addressing these performance issues could enhance overall system responsiveness and user satisfaction.
